subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should the bundled dashboard binding model support command bindings, and if so what allowlist, approval, scope, interval, and audit boundary should govern them?
rationale: Stream and computed bindings are product design work, but command bindings cross into scheduled command execution from dashboard data and cannot be safely queued without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Design boundary after foundation
options.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard base lands, then require a narrow design for command allowlisting and approvals before code.

options.title: Split safer bindings first
options.body: Allow stream and computed bindings to proceed separately while command bindings stay blocked on security design.

options.title: Externalize command bindings
options.body: Keep command-backed data sources out of the bundled dashboard and require a separate plugin or ClawHub package for that high-power behavior.

recommendation.title: Design boundary after foundation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard base lands, then require a narrow design for command allowlisting and approvals before code.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the plugin tab seam and recent bundled plugin product boundary.
